messages.content: Help me generate a new ChartSeries with initial settings including axis labels `axisLabelsArray`, data points `dataPointsArray`, and a default color scheme `defaultColor`, and then integrate it into a specific chart layout `chartLayoutObject`?

function.name: ChartSeriesGenerator
function.description: This function creates a new ChartSeries with customizable settings for axis labels, data points, and color schemes, and attaches it to a given chart layout. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

labels.description: The labels for the chart's axis. This is JavaScript array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type String; they are not in string representation.

data.description: The data points for the series. This is JavaScript array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type String; they are not in string representation.

color.description: The default color for the series. Optional parameter. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

chartLayout.description: The layout object of the chart where the series will be added. This is JavaScript dict type parameter in string representation.

message.content:
Below is a ready‑to‑paste JavaScript snippet that shows how to call the **ChartSeriesGenerator** tool with your own data.  
Just replace the placeholder arrays, color, and layout object with the real values you want to use.

```javascript
// 1️⃣  Define your data (replace these with your real values)
const axisLabelsArray   = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar'];          // <-- your axis labels
const dataPointsArray   = [10, 20, 30];                   // <-- your data points
const defaultColor      = '#3498db';                      // <-- your default color
const chartLayoutObject = { title: 'Monthly Sales' };     // <-- your chart layout

// 2️⃣  Call the tool – the arguments must be *stringified* JavaScript objects
const newSeries = ChartSeriesGenerator({
  labels: JSON.stringify(axisLabelsArray),   // e.g. '["Jan","Feb","Mar"]'
  data:   JSON.stringify(dataPointsArray),   // e.g. '[10,20,30]'
  color:  defaultColor,                     // e.g. '#3498db'
  chartLayout: JSON.stringify(chartLayoutObject) // e.g. '{"title":"Monthly Sales"}'
});

// 3️⃣  `newSeries` now holds the created ChartSeries instance
console.log(newSeries);
```

### What the tool expects

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `labels` | `string` | JSON‑encoded array of label strings (e.g. `'["Jan","Feb"]'`) |
| `data` | `string` | JSON‑encoded array of data points (e.g. `'[10,20]'`) |
| `color` | `string` (optional) | Hex or CSS color string (e.g. `'#ff0000'`) |
| `chartLayout` | `string` | JSON‑encoded layout object (e.g. `'{"title":"Sales"}'`) |

Feel free to adjust the arrays, color, and layout to match your chart’s requirements. Once you run this snippet, the new series will be attached to the specified chart layout automatically.
